notes: Instantiation (b) of architect-editor-pair on hermes: a plan->implement MODE pair (one model) captured ACROSS the approval gate, asserting the full arc ready->working->waiting->working->ready. The architect is the bundled `/plan` skill (skills/software-development/plan/SKILL.md, '# Plan Mode', 'for this turn you are planning only'), whose own 'Execution Handoff' section prescribes closing the turn with '... Shall I proceed?' and then executing on approval; the editor is the post-approval turn that creates a real skill file with skill_manage. RECORD-TIME RE-SPEC: the assessment assumed write_file, but this install exposes no workspace file tool at all (37-function roster, no write_file/patch/read_file/terminal; execute_code dies on 'docker version') because the recording home's config.yaml sets terminal.backend: docker and the whole terminal+file toolset is gated behind check_terminal_requirements/check_file_requirements. skill_manage(action='create') writes a genuine SKILL.md on disk, and the substitution is invisible at the layer this cell asserts - irrlicht observes transitions, message rows and tool_calls, never file paths. Instantiation (a) - two models in one turn, each with its own ModelName - is NOT asserted and is not expressible on this transport: hermes has no architect/editor pairing, and the aux-model usage it does record lands in the session_model_usage table, which the adapter never reads (it reads only `sessions` and `messages`). Hermes writes NO transcript file; the daemon observes the one shared store at $HERMES_HOME/state.db via agent.ProcessOwnedStore. THE CHAIN: (1) the /plan expansion lands as a `user` row -> user_message -> the classifier's total default transcript_activity -> working; (2) the plan turn's role='assistant' finish_reason='stop' row carries the ask, and parser.go computes PendingWaitingCue from the FULL text before truncation while rewriting the SAME row to turn_done, so classifyAgentDone checks IsWaitingForUserInput BEFORE routing to ready and the session goes working->waiting with no ready in between; (3) THE LEG THIS CELL ADDS - the approval reply lands as another `user` row and metrics.go's messageFold.apply explicitly resets pendingWaitingCue ('a new user message answers whatever the agent was waiting on') and clears open tools, so IsAgentDone goes false, no higher ladder rule claims the pass (hermes has no hook tier, no permission-pending signal), and transcript_activity fires waiting->working; (4) the implement turn's cue-free stop row settles working->ready. DISTINCTNESS: 2.18 user-blocking-plan-mode-approval records the SAME /plan->pause entry but TERMINATES at the waiting gate (final state waiting). This cell continues PAST approval - a recording that ends in waiting is a duplicate of 2.18 and a FAILURE. The waiting is derived from the generic prose rule, so in the store this pause is indistinguishable from an ordinary trailing-question turn: hermes writes no structured approval marker. session_birth is anchored to start UNPINNED because hermes carries a Process matcher (processlifecycle mints a transient proc-<PID> presession at launch) while the real `sessions` row is INSERTed only on the first user message; architect_plan establishes the real session and every later phase chains via same_session_as, so the post-approval recovery is proven on the SAME session that gated. NO metric observations are pinned and that is deliberate: `of verify` hard-asserts against the replay golden, and the replay path runs hermes.Parser over a transcript rather than ComputeMetrics over the store, so a hermes golden carries zero tokens/cost. The scenario's token and model criteria - TotalTokens strictly greater after the implement turn than at the plan gate, and ONE consistent ModelName across both phases (sessions.model) - are asserted on the live metrics surface in the recipe's verify[] instead. `model` is filled from the recording (gpt-5.6-luna) and confirmed against the replay golden.

text: The hermes session appears in ready. UNPINNED: the `sessions` row is INSERTed on the first user message (the /plan expansion), not at launch, so the ready birth comes from the transient proc-<PID> presession the processlifecycle scanner mints - it must not steal the identity the arc lands on.

ARCHITECT / plan phase. The /plan turn drives the hermes session ready -> working: the expanded skill invocation lands as a `user` row and message_count grows while the newest row is not assistant/finish_reason='stop'. The turn spans many 2s poll ticks (the model reads a ~6k-token skill body and writes the plan file under .hermes/plans/), so the working leg is observed on its own merits rather than via catch-up synthesis.

The plan-approval gate. The agent saves the plan and ends the turn asking whether to proceed; that turn-boundary row (assistant/finish_reason='stop') carries the ask, so PendingWaitingCue and turn_done arrive together and classifyAgentDone routes working -> waiting, never through ready. The 'no ready before approval' invariant is enforced STRUCTURALLY by the phase chain rather than by a window invariant - plan_gate is the first waiting after architect_plan(working), editor_implement the first working after plan_gate, turn_end the first ready after editor_implement - so the ordering itself proves no ready interposed. A 'no state_transition to ready' invariant would be WRONG here: unlike 2.18, this cell DOES go ready after approval.

EDITOR / implement phase - the leg 2.18 does not have. The user approves with an ordinary message (hermes' gate is prose, not a modal, so no keystroke primitive is involved). That `user` row resets the waiting cue and clears open tools in messageFold.apply, IsAgentDone goes false, and the classifier's transcript_activity default drives waiting -> working on the SAME session that gated. The agent then applies a real skill_manage(action='create') call, writing a genuine SKILL.md under $HERMES_HOME/skills/software-development/ - the editor's artifact, standing in for ./mycli.py because this install's workspace file tools are config-gated off (see the record-time re-spec caveat).

The implement turn finishes: an assistant/finish_reason='stop' row whose text carries NO trailing question, so agent_done routes working -> ready. Final state is ready. Ending in waiting instead would mean either the model closed on a question (a recipe/prompt failure) or the run stopped at the gate - the latter being a duplicate of 2.18 and a failure of this cell.
